name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Added a Downloads section to the Federation settings page: every download in progress (or recently finished) shows its progress bar, transfer speed, and a Cancel button, in one place instead of only being visible on the item's own detail page.

Added a circular progress ring drawn right over an item's cover art while it's downloading - on the poster in library grids, search results, and home rows, and on the detail page's own cover image - since the item already has its real artwork synced from the friend's server, this just overlays progress on what's already there. Updates live wherever that cover art currently appears, not just on the page you started the download from.

Download speed is now tracked and shown everywhere progress is shown (the pill, the toast, the new dashboard section, and the ring's percentage) - computed from actual bytes transferred, sampled about once a second so it reads as a stable number instead of jumping around.

196 tests (unchanged - this release is UI/progress-reporting work, the download mechanism itself is unchanged: still a direct authenticated HTTP transfer from the friend's server to yours).
